name: com.gameframex.unity.tuyoogame.yooasset.tiktok
description:
YooAsset TikTok (international) mini-game FileSystem adapter skeleton for Unity WebGL — placeholder package reserving the runtime surface for the international TikTok SDK integration. Currently ships only a CroppingHelper stub; the IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider + IFileSystem implementation will be added once the international TikTok SDK is finalized.
YooAsset TikTok（国际版）小游戏 WebGL FileSystem 适配骨架包——为国际版 TikTok SDK 接入预留运行时空位，当前仅含 CroppingHelper 占位类，IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider 与 IFileSystem 实现待国际版 SDK 确定后补齐。
